audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record: C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\delta_airlines_2026.json. Checker: structure OK; 66 exact, 1 loose, 0 on another page, 0 missing (of 67). The loose quote is the mandatory prepayment sentence on p6, which wraps past the two-line label 'Mandatory Prepayments and / Commitment Reductions:'.

The document-to-record walk of all 12 pages (dump, plus page images 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 10 and 12) found no term missing from a row, no term in the wrong row and no wrong figure. Every amount, ratio, period and date in the record matches the page and the tranche or covenant it is attributed to. Pricing, fees, default interest, conditions precedent and representations (pp. 3-7, 12) have no row in the template and are deliberately not recorded.

Doubts the term sheet itself cannot resolve:
1. Mandatory prepayment (p6): the sentence has no conjunction between 'exceed the amount of the commitments under the Revolving Facility' and 'to the extent necessary to comply with the Asset Coverage Ratio'. It is recorded as two triggers; the second is independently supported on p9. The ambiguity is in the note.
2. Event of default 5 (p10): whether 'in each case in connection with defaults resulting from changes in the appraised value of Pool Assets' also limits the affirmative-covenant cure periods is unclear; it is reproduced as written.
3. 'Initial Revolving Credit Agreement' (p9, used for EBITDAR, Interest Expense and appraised value) is never defined. The record does not assert that it is the Existing Credit Agreement.
4. 'Double negative pledge' (p8) is named but not described, so the printed lines only carve it out and point to the Negative Pledge row.
5. The LC Tranche is printed as $0 on p1 and p2 (confirmed on the page images; 'LC Tranche: None' for upfront fees on p4 is consistent). It is recorded as printed; whether $0 is a placeholder cannot be told.
6. The jurisdiction of Delta Air Lines, Inc. is not stated; the row stays not_stated with New York governing law on the second line. A search of the dump found only the 'domiciled in the United States' insurance wording and the 'Delaware Divisions' heading.

Judgement calls confirmed and left unchanged:
- guarantor_coverage stays stated as a derived 'None': it follows directly from 'Guarantors: None.' on p1.
- maturity stays stated: the tenors are express; only the Extension Option is by reference, and the line says so.
- conditions_subsequent stays not_stated: there is no post-closing obligation in the term sheet.
- Refinancing Revolving Facilities stay in the accordion row; the $1.0bn accordion figure is derived ($3.65bn cap less $2.65bn) and labelled as such.
- The 60-day Asset Coverage remedy appears in fc_other, mandatory_prepayment and events_of_default, and the annual appraisal in fc_testing and info_budget. I left the repetition because each row needs the point.
- Four lines exceed the ~250-character style target, all within the 420 limit: events_of_default line 2 (277), other_covenants line 4 (269), fc_other line 1 and mandatory_prepayment line 3 (251 each).

doc.title: DELTA AIR LINES, INC. REVOLVING CREDIT FACILITY - Summary of Principal Terms and Conditions
doc.notes: Posting-version summary of principal terms for a new $2.65bn senior unsecured revolving credit facility for Delta Air Lines, Inc. (JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Agent and Lead Arranger); the term sheet itself is undated and refers to a Commitment Letter dated May 6, 2026. The terms are on pages 1-11 in a two-column label / value layout under sections A to E; Schedule I on page 12 is the ratings-based pricing grid. It is not an amendment with existing and proposed columns, but the facility refinances the Existing Credit Agreement (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated November 6, 2023) and several points are given only by reference to it: 'Same as set forth in the Existing Credit Agreement' (extension option, refinancing facilities, assignments and participations), conditions precedent 'substantially consistent with' it, and the 'Documentation Principles' (terms no less favourable to the Borrower than the Existing Credit Agreement, modified for the Collateral Release Date). It is indicative only, says it does not describe all terms of the Credit Documentation, and gives no lender commitments.
